The '''Black Hole dark trooper''' was a variant of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]].

==History==
They were modeled on [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Blackhole]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]S and were often deployed with units of those troopers.
